item.title: Dubstep signs Abhay Deol as its brand ambassador
item.description: Dubstep has announced the appointment of actor Abhay Deol as its brand ambassador. item.title: Omnicom and Google develop search agent to provide insights into consumer intent
item.description: Omnicom has partnered with Google to introduce a new tool designed to help brands better understand consumer search behaviour in an AI-driven environment. The collaboration centres on the Consumer Prompt Insights Agent, which the agency and the tech company are developing as part of their ongoing Future of Search partnership. item.title: India to overtake China as largest SVOD market by 2030: Report
item.description: India is projected to overtake China to become the world’s largest market for subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) by 2030, with 358 million individual subscriptions, according to a new report by Media Partners Asia. However, the country’s overall premium video-on-demand revenue, including subscriptions and advertising, is expected to remain significantly smaller than that of other major Asian markets. item.title: Cheil Worldwide onboards Sungkyoon Kim as President & CEO at Cheil South West Asia
item.description: Cheil Worldwide has appointed Sungkyoon Kim as President and Chief Executive Officer of Cheil South West Asia. The move marks a leadership change at the Samsung-backed advertising and marketing network’s regional operations. Kim succeeds Carlos LimSeob Chung, who has moved into a new role within Cheil Worldwide, the global marketing communications arm of Samsung Group. item.description: Concept PR has secured the corporate communications mandate for Bank of India, as announced on Tuesday, with the mandate taking effect immediately. item.title: Why Vinod Kunj says regional advertising must be lived, not translated
item.description: Advertising tends to work best when it is built around how people actually live, not how markets are defined on paper. As brands have expanded their presence beyond metros, regional advertising has grown in volume and visibility, but not always in depth. item.title: Musk's xAI raises $20 billion in Series E funding
item.description: Elon Musk’s xAI, and developer of the Grok chatbot, has announced that it has raised $20 billion in a Series E funding round. In a blog post, the company said investors include Valor Equity Partners, Fidelity and the Qatar Investment Authority. item.title: Bangladesh bans IPL broadcasts after KKR releases Mustafizur Rahman
item.description: Bangladesh’s interim government has banned the broadcast of this year’s Indian Premier League (IPL), escalating tensions with neighbouring India that have now spilled into cricket relations, Al Jazeera reported.
